items.desc: Abbe May is Western Australia’s very own fruit-forward, fairy godmother of rock. Known for her big guitar riffs and bigger hats, she’s one of our most respected and beloved performers; a phenomenal songwriter, guitarist and mentor. Abbe spent her late teens and early twenties on the stages of some of Australia’s most notorious rock venues and festivals, playing alongside Neneh Cherry, The Black Keys, Midnight Oil, The Motels, Art vs. Science, Tim Rogers, Adalita and so many more! With the 2010s came a turn toward solo work and her album Design Desire, followed by the critically acclaimed Kiss…
items.title: No Skips with Abbe May

items.desc: Over the last two decades, Welsh musician and producer Cate Le Bon has built a catalogue of soft-worn post-punk and abstract art-pop, and a sound entirely her own. She’s also played a role in shaping the work of some truly beloved indie acts over the last decade, from Dry Cleaning to Kurt Vile, Wilco, St Vincent and Horsegirl. In this conversation with Pam Boland, recorded in April of 2026 following the release of her album Michelangelo Dying, Cate share the songs that have most influenced her creatively, her love of physical media and the making of her latest album. items.title: No Skips with Cate Le Bon
